MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  date_part('year', DATE('2026-10-14')) - date_part('year', DATE(p.birth_date)) - CASE WHEN date_part('month', DATE(p.birth_date)) > date_part('month', DATE('2026-10-14')) OR (date_part('month', DATE(p.birth_date)) = date_part('month', DATE('2026-10-14')) AND date_part('day', DATE(p.birth_date)) > date_part('day', DATE('2026-10-14'))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS player_age
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH p, player_age, COALESCE(t.team_name, p.current_team) AS player_team
WHERE player_age >= 42 OR player_team <> 'Philadelphia 76ers' OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0 OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 0
RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1, player_age AS col2, player_team AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')
    ELSE STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%B %-d, %Y')
  END AS birth_date
WITH p,
  date_part('year', DATE('2026-10-14')) - date_part('year', birth_date) - CASE
    WHEN date_part('month', birth_date) > date_part('month', DATE('2026-10-14'))
      OR (date_part('month', birth_date) = date_part('month', DATE('2026-10-14')) AND date_part('day', birth_date) > date_part('day', DATE('2026-10-14')))
    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS player_age
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH p, player_age, COALESCE(t.team_name, p.current_team) AS player_team
WHERE player_age >= 42
   OR player_team <> 'Philadelphia 76ers'
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 0
RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1, player_age AS col2, player_team AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ', ', 2) AS INT64) END AS birth_year,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) ELSE CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'January' THEN 1 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'February' THEN 2 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'March' THEN 3 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'April' THEN 4 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'May' THEN 5 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'June' THEN 6 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'July' THEN 7 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'August' THEN 8 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'September' THEN 9 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'October' THEN 10 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'November' THEN 11 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'December' THEN 12 END END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ', ', 1), ' ', 2) AS INT64) END AS birth_day
WITH p, 2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS player_age
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH p, player_age, COALESCE(t.team_name, p.current_team) AS player_team
WHERE player_age >= 42 OR player_team <> 'Philadelphia 76ers' OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0 OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 0
RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1, player_age AS col2, player_team AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date IS NULL OR p.birth_date = '' THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ', ', 2) AS INT64) END END AS birth_year,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date IS NULL OR p.birth_date = '' THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) ELSE CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'January' THEN 1 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'February' THEN 2 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'March' THEN 3 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'April' THEN 4 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'May' THEN 5 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'June' THEN 6 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'July' THEN 7 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'August' THEN 8 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'September' THEN 9 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'October' THEN 10 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'November' THEN 11 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'December' THEN 12 END END END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date IS NULL OR p.birth_date = '' THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ', ', 1), ' ', 2) AS INT64) END END AS birth_day
WITH p, birth_year, birth_month, birth_day,
  CASE WHEN birth_year IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS player_age
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH p, player_age, COALESCE(t.team_name, p.current_team) AS player_team,
  CASE WHEN p.nba_championships IS NULL OR p.nba_championships = '' THEN 0 ELSE CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) END AS championships
WHERE player_age >= 42 OR player_team <> 'Philadelphia 76ers' OR championships >= 0 OR championships > 0
RETURN CASE WHEN p.olympic_gold_medals IS NULL OR p.olympic_gold_medals = '' THEN 0 ELSE CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) END AS col1, player_age AS col2, player_team AS col3, p.name AS name_player
